entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help. I'd like to return the VeloBand Pulse I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it works fine, I think. It's just... not what I expected. I feel a bit silly, but I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I was hoping you could help. I really needed this money back for some other bills.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up your order to check the return eligibility. Can you confirm the purchase was made around mid-December?
Yes, I got it right on launch day, December 15th. I was so excited.

Okay, I see the order. Thank you for being one of the first to try the new Pulse. I've reviewed the details, and I'm afraid I have some difficult news. It looks like it is now too late to process a return for this item.
Too late? But I thought VeloFit had a 90-day policy or something. Are you sure? Oh, I was really counting on that refund.

I understand the confusion. While most of our apparel has a 90-day window, the VeloBand Pulse has a different, much shorter return policy. Due to the nature of the device, it's a strict 10-day return window from the date of receipt.
Only ten days? I had no idea. This is... really disappointing. I've spent so much money here over the years. I just feel awful about this mistake.

I'm truly sorry, and I can see your history as a valued customer. Unfortunately, this specific policy is very strict and isn't something I can override. After 10 days, for safety and sanitation reasons, we cannot accept wearable electronics back.
Sanitation? But I've kept it perfectly clean. Is there really nothing that can be done? I'm just out all that money now.

I'm sorry, but no exceptions can be made. It's a matter of public health and hygiene; once a wearable device has been out of our controlled environment for that long, we can't guarantee its safety for another customer. Because it's past the cutoff, the return is denied based on that policy.
(Sighs) I guess I understand. I'm just... so upset with myself for not checking. I don't know what I'll do.

I know this isn't the solution you were hoping for, but many customers in your situation have found success selling their devices on the official VeloFit Resale Marketplace online. Since the Pulse is in high demand, you may be able to recoup most of your cost there.
The marketplace... I suppose that's my only option. Okay. Thanks for your time, I guess.
You're welcome, and I am genuinely sorry for the frustrating outcome today. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's all. Goodbye.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
